meta.title: IIT JEE coaching in Chinchwad | D-SAP Ghule Tutorials
meta.description: JEE coaching for Chinchwad students at our Wakad branch, over the Mother Teresa Flyover. Online lectures help on long-trip days.

intro: Chinchwad is one of the farther areas we serve. Our Wakad branch is about {{commute:chinchwad#km}} km away, and the head office in New Sangvi is about the same distance.

sections.heading: Chinchwad to Wakad

body.text: Take the Mother Teresa Flyover, then Hedgewar Road and Kaspate Vasti Road down to Wakad.

body: On a longer trip like this one, leave home early enough to arrive before {{fact:batch.timings#start}} without rushing.

body.text: Lectures are also online. On a day when traffic or a school event makes the trip hard, your child can watch the class later and stay on track.
Chinchwad has the Pimpri Chinchwad Science Park, with interactive exhibits. It is a good weekend visit for a student who likes to see Physics at work.
Chinchwad students can join for two years from Class 11, or for one year in Class 12.

questions.q: Which centre is nearer to Chinchwad?
questions.a: Wakad, by a little: about {{commute:chinchwad#km}} km. New Sangvi is close behind.

questions.q: What if my child misses a class?

a.text: The lecture is online too, so it can be watched later.
